en: The postcard features a sepia-toned photograph of a town square bordered by historic buildings with steep, traditional European rooftops. A large tree stands prominently in the middle of the square. Several shop signs are visible on the buildings, and the image has a peaceful, early 20th-century atmosphere. At the bottom, the text 'Strehla a. Elbe.' and 'Markt.' is printed in red, with publishing information below.
